index.title: United in Times
index.desc_1: We are a youth organization committed to Bulgarian traditions, active citizenship, and conservatism.
index.principle_1_p: We believe in the hierarchy of values, order, and continuity. For us, conservatism is not merely a political stance, but a philosophy of creation that values time-tested institutions such as family, faith, and community, protecting them from the destructive currents of modern times.
index.principle_2_p: Preserving Bulgarian culture, history, and national identity is at the core of our work. Traditions are the foundation upon which a sustainable state is built. Through them, we preserve historical memory and strengthen national consciousness for future generations.
index.principle_3_p: We believe in personal responsibility toward the community. We encourage participation in public life through education, cultural initiatives, and volunteering. Active citizenship means conscious commitment to heritage and readiness to act in defense of values.
index.principle_4_p: We support the inviolable right to personal initiative and property as a foundation for development. A free and responsible individual contributes most effectively to the common good. Respect for labor and a stable economic environment are key to building a strong and independent community.
index.loc_desc: Every week we hold regular meetings where we plan our future initiatives and discuss important societal topics. Come and meet us in person.
